verdict.rationale: HeyGen's developer docs claim every endpoint ships with 'typed schemas' alongside llms.txt and an MCP server, which suggests machine-readable endpoint definitions. However, no downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec file is documented, and probes of the common OpenAPI/Swagger paths all returned 404. llms.txt exists, but it is a documentation index rather than an API spec. Missing for 10: a documented, downloadable OpenAPI/Swagger (or equivalent) spec URL, confirmation of what format the 'typed schemas' take, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
